# opencode-cron

> ChatGPT Scheduled Tasks for opencode — session-bound cron + persistent memory for AI agents.

## Install

```jsonc
// opencode.json
{ "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugin": ["@culturedigitali/opencode-cron"] }
```

## Chat quickstart

- `/cron-add` → "Watch AI news, every 5m" (creates job bound to this session)
- `cron_list` → verify id, enabled, next run
- `cron_run_now` → test tick immediately

## TUI-closed runs

```bash
npx @culturedigitali/opencode-cron os-install --dir /path/to/project
npx @culturedigitali/opencode-cron check --dir /path/to/project
```
